text_block_list.text:
With her target race, the Japanese Derby, drawing near,
Symboli Rudolf's training was entering its final stages.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Thank you for agreeing to run alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No... The pleasure is mine...
Um, well... I'll take my leave now...

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, that was terrifying...
The President is way too strong..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, thank you.
I put you through a lot of trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Selecting a partner for tandem training, that is.
Must have been quite an uphill battle."

...I see. Since you're dealing with the "Emperor,"
everyone felt intimidated and said, "I'm not cut out for this,"
making it difficult to find someone to take the role.
I pleaded with a trainer I know and managed to secure one candidate, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel terrible for her, too.
It seems I gave her quite a fright.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I try my best not to intimidate others,
but while running, it simply can't be helped.
choice_data_list: The real race is close, after all.
The real race is close, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I might be feeling on edge
without even realizing it myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Derby is the ultimate dream
of everyone involved in racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I am to truly call myself the "Emperor," dropping this is naturally out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's not much time left until the race.
Let's stay focused and keep up the conditioning.
Leading up to the race, Symboli Rudolf spent each day fulfilling both body and mind.
Then, one day――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you walk with me
all the way to the student council room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's something I need to confirm before training.
It'll only take a moment, so please wait for me.
choice_data_list: ...Can't we leave it to someone else?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, that is not an option,
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Failing to notice the troubles of those close to me
was because I had been neglecting my Student Council duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To ensure no other child suffers from such anxiety and distress ever again,
I must balance both even more diligently than before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I cannot handle at least this much,
I will never achieve my ideals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...And.
This is...

She came to a halt in front of the student council room.
She seemed to be staring at a piece of paper posted on the door.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's doing, I take it?
Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I assume this is out of concern for my health.
I appreciate the sentiment, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even so, it's rare for her to resort to such strong-arm tactics—
(Click!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Tch! Give me a break."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian, you're full of spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...President.
Good timing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I got dragged right into your mess,
good grief.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Tell me why.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... So Air Groove asked you,
and you handled the work that was supposed to come to me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That "Empress" lady was quite persistent this time around.
Thanks to that, my schedule is completely ruined.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm sorry.
It's entirely my fault."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because of my own unworthiness, I made Air Groove worry about me,
and in the end, caused trouble for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to apologize once again.
I am truly sorry."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No, there's really no need to apologize...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever. I'm going on patrol.
I'll leave the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...This needs to be revised.
I must order a recalculation of the budget."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President?
Aren't you supposed to be training right now...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What are you working on?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I was looking over the second-term
budget proposals for each committee.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, it must be tough on you.
I'll help you out too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm summarizing it right now so
the President only needs to give her approval later.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is an important period for you,
so leave this to me and focus on your training—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove.
Who is the president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Allocating and choosing tasks is my job.
No matter my situation, leave it to me without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you really distrust me that much?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly think student council duties
are enough to trip me up and cause my defeat?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, no...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then there shouldn't be any problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I appreciate the thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "And that's how it is. My apologies, Trainer-kun. I'll clean this up right away, so please bear with me a moment longer."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
My apologies. Well then...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I feel bad asking you to do menial tasks,
but please help out with sorting through the documents."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.
In the end, task after task kept popping up that day, delaying the start of our training, but—
Symboli Rudolf handled everything on the schedule without a hitch.
